result.summary: Shrivana Textile Mills currently has three open overdue notifications totaling INR 21M across two policies (WT and SCF), the oldest being 50 days past due (INR 11M, due 2026-10-04). Historical resolutions show days-late worsening steadily (10→14→22 days) and notification frequency has doubled in the last 6-month window (4 vs 2 prior, from 2 policies), indicating a clear deterioration in payment discipline. Combined open exposure (~21M) remains within granted limits (100M combined) but the pattern warrants closer monitoring or limit tightening.
